title: reduce-presubmit-cost-eviction-safelist-and-lint-warm-cache
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: presubmit lanes are consuming more runner CPU and extending developer feedback cycles. This PR introduces an eviction safelist to prevent automated eviction of critical infra dependencies and adds an opt-in lint warm-cache mechanism to presubmit jobs. The safelist is a lightweight manifest that the dependency rotation bot consults; evicting a safelisted dependency now requires a bot-created suggestion PR, a Linear ticket, and a two-step human approval flow. The lint warm-cache action persists and restores lint caches keyed to repo+branch+commit-range to avoid cross-branch contamination. Goals: reduce average lint runtime ~35%, cut presubmit cost, and reduce churn from aggressive dependency eviction. Rollout: staged (fastpath lanes -> wider presubmit) with feature flag. Checklist: [x] design doc (Linear ENG-2301) [x] unit and smoke tests for eviction gate [x] opt-in rollout to repos [x] docs updated in dev-infra. Risks and mitigations: safelist stored in repo with audit history and limited edit rights; eviction requires two approvers for safelisted items; cache key scoping minimizes pollution. Migration: add dev-infra/eviction-safelist.yaml to repos to protect and enable ci/actions/lint-warm-cache.yml in your presubmit workflow to opt-in. Related: ENG-2301, ENG-2378.

release_notes: Introduce eviction safelist to reduce automated churn for critical infra deps.
Add opt-in lint warm-cache action to presubmit to speed up lint runs and reduce cold starts.
Require two-step approval for eviction of safelisted dependencies; preserve audit trail.
change_summary: Adds an eviction safelist, implements a conservative bot gate and approval flow, and introduces an opt-in lint warm-cache action to reduce presubmit CI cost and developer latency.
rationale: Automated dependency eviction created noisy churn and occasional infra breakages; presubmit lint cold-starts amplify costs. A safelist plus conservative human-in-the-loop for sensitive deps keeps rotation benefits while reducing risk; warm caching reduces repeated work without changing lint semantics.
review_comments: Ben Gomez: How will we track safelist edits over time? Need an audit/offchain log and ownership mapping.
Aisha Patel: Safelist is checked into dev-infra with CODEOWNERS and a commit-hook that records a Linear ticket ID and retains a changelog entry for every edit.
Linh Tran: Concerned about cache contamination across branches. Suggest scoping keys to repo+branch+commit-range and using a short TTL.
Aisha Patel: Implemented key scheme repo:branch:startSHA-endSHA and added a 7-day TTL and opt-in flag per repo.
Carlos Silva: What happens if bot suggests eviction for a safelisted dep in a release branch?
Aisha Patel: Bot will open a suggestion PR and mark it "eviction-suggested" with a linked Linear ticket; the premerge gate blocks merge until two approvers explicitly /approve-eviction.
